omissions: Original Astra reasons remain preserved as the earlier preparation. The 3 October no-quota reassessment now selects Fulham, West Ham, Cardiff, Stoke away, the Arsenal FA Cup exit and Newcastle away because each has its own substantive result, comeback or milestone.

West Brom 4–1 includes another Suárez hat-trick; Norwich’s four-goal milestone and Cardiff’s two-deficit nine-goal contest provide stronger separate stories. The West Brom result remains available as chronology rather than a further selected report.

Christmas away defeats at Manchester City and Chelsea are retained as verified turning-point context for the return title-rival fixtures, rather than selected simply because of the opponent. The pair explains the Christmas lead giving way to fourth place.

Notts County’s extra-time League Cup win and the Manchester United third-round exit, plus Oldham and Bournemouth FA Cup wins, were assessed in the full 43-game ledger. The Arsenal fifth-round defeat supplies the decisive domestic-cup endpoint; the other ties lack a stronger distinct season milestone than the 19 selected games.

The 3–2 home Swansea game, the 4–0 home Tottenham win and routine high-scoring home fixtures remain part of the eleven league wins; selected Fulham, West Ham, Cardiff, Arsenal, City and Norwich retain the varied contest and its outcome without selecting every victory.
